header: This is what the search line needs to know about this topic (pure, no React): the words of the DSP story card ("dsp history", "heads of dsp", "queen elizabeth durgapur", "sail history"). The data, its sources and its checks are in history.ts and history.selftest.ts; how it looks is in DspHistoryCard.tsx and ui.tsx. It is listed once, in src/tools/registry.ts. Only NAMES of more than one word are key words here (no single word like "history" or "heads" opens the card). I did that so "dsp" alone, "history" alone, "who is the head of dsp" and ordinary searches about the plant stay with the search they were: a line is this card's when it has one of these names and every other word is one of the card's extra words or a filler. `lang` says which tab to open.
